title: imagebuildah: resolve ARG before additional context lookup
body:
## Summary

When a `FROM` value names an additional build context through an `ARG`, Buildah currently looks up the literal `{BASE_IMAGE}` token before expanding the argument. The context is missed and the unresolved name is treated as a registry image.

Resolve the `FROM` value before checking additional contexts, then substitute the image context in the parsed instruction. Apply the same ordering when determining base images for `--all-platforms`.

Fixes #7178.
